name: Step into the Void
summary: The attacker takes a step — and the ground is gone. The Auros defend by not being there.

face.name: Step into the Void

effect.name: Effect
effect.text: Return an opponent Entity to its owner's hand; you may play it as a block against an attacker, removing it from the wave. Its assigned Object goes to the Abyss.

face.flavor: They did not parry the blow. They removed the target.
